user.title: PREdistribuce (Consumption Profiles)
user.description: Enter the login for your PREdistribuce customer portal account. It is used only to read consumption data — nothing is changed on the portal.

data_description.username: Email or customer number used to log in to predistribuce.cz

eans.title: Metering points and schedule
eans.description: Select which metering points (EANs) to import, and the local time of day when the daily import should run.

data_description.eans: At least one must be selected.
data_description.import_time: Local time as configured in Home Assistant (Settings → System → General) when the daily import should run. Note: the previous day's data only becomes available from the distributor early the following day, in the Europe/Prague time zone (UTC+1/+2 depending on daylight saving). If it isn't closed yet, this integration creates a repair issue (Settings → Repairs) — the next scheduled import does NOT retry it automatically, you need to resolve the repair issue to retry.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate PREdistribuce (Consumption Profiles)
reauth_confirm.description: The login for account "{username}" is no longer valid. Enter the current password to continue.

data_description.import_time: Local time as configured in Home Assistant (Settings → System → General) when the daily import should run. Note: the previous day's data only becomes available from the distributor early the following day, in the Europe/Prague time zone (UTC+1/+2 depending on daylight saving). If it isn't closed yet, this integration creates a repair issue (Settings → Repairs) — the next scheduled import does NOT retry it automatically, you need to resolve the repair issue to retry.

metering_points.title: Metering points
metering_points.description: Select which metering points (EANs) should be imported. A newly added one only starts importing from now on — a repair issue will offer to backfill once a day's data becomes available.

data_description.ean: Metering point (EAN) to import — must already be configured for this account.
data_description.date_to: Last day to import (inclusive). Automatically capped to yesterday — today's consumption is always zero.
